tests.name: local-db-upgrade-path-2x-and-smoke-tests
tests.command: npx.cmd supabase@2.120.0 db reset --workdir <localdb> && docker exec supabase_db_chronoledger-local psql -U postgres -d postgres -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f /tmp/BASE_SCHEMA.sql && psql -c "INSERT INTO storage.buckets (id, name, public) VALUES ('user-icons', 'user-icons', false);" && psql -f sql/migrations/MIGRATION_R107C_AUTO_CONFIRM.sql (x2) && psql -f r107c_check.sql && psql -f sql/tests/TESTS.sql
